Name: Toffee's Parrots for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from Toffeeko, I've updated their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13259]Parrots[/url] to 1.6!

There are quite a few varieties of parrots in this mod, and they produce a colorful variety of feathers: 

-African Grey (red feathers)
-Blue Mask Lovebird (blue feathers)
-Blue Peach Lovebird (blue feathers)
-Cockatiel (white feathers)
-Cockatoo (white feathers)
-Green Mask Lovebird (green feathers)
-Green Peach Lovebird (green feathers)
-Island Parrot (the OG Ginger Island one!) (rainbow feathers)
-Void Parrot (black feathers)

The parrots live in barns, and when you put their feathers through an oil maker, they'll produce parrot paint. All parrots will also drop valuable Gilded Quills with high friendship (these can be turned into gold paint the same way as the regular feathers)

Enjoy!
